symbols.name: transform length
symbols.meaning: The number of ring elements transformed along one axis, a power of two dividing 2r.
symbols.quote: It orders the outputs of the [synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) $F_t^-$ over $\mathcal R_r$, where $t$ is the transform length and $a=\log_2t$ the number of rounds.

symbols.name: number of rounds
symbols.meaning: The number log_2 t of rounds of the fast algorithm.
symbols.quote: It orders the outputs of the [synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) $F_t^-$ over $\mathcal R_r$, where $t$ is the transform length and $a=\log_2t$ the number of rounds.

symbols.name: root of unity
symbols.meaning: The power y^{2r/t} of the ring variable used as the t-th root of unity.
symbols.quote: For $t$ a power of two dividing $2r$, define $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$; every power of $\omega_t$ is an isometry, so each entry is an average of $t$ isometric images and both normalized transforms are contractions.

symbols.name: two-point butterfly
symbols.meaning: The 2x2 matrix (1/2)[[1,1],[1,-1]] applied to each pair of entries.
symbols.quote: With $H_0=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$ the two-point butterfly, apply $H_0$ to each pair, multiply the $b=1$ output by $\omega_t^{-k}$, and recurse on the two length-$t/2$ branches.

symbols.name: bit-reversal permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of records moving the entry at j to rev_a(j).
symbols.quote: Let $B_t$ be the permutation moving the entry at $j$ to $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$

symbols.name: parallel butterfly
symbols.meaning: The butterfly layer applying H_0 on every participating axis at once.
symbols.quote: With several axes, a round applies $H_0$ on every axis at once, one parallel butterfly $\mathcal H$.

symbols.name: current length
symbols.meaning: The current recursive length of axis i.
symbols.quote: Here $u_i$ is axis $i$'s current length, $b_i$ its new branch bit and $k_i$ the index encoded by its unprocessed slots, so $E$ depends on the address, not on coefficient values.

symbols.name: branch bit
symbols.meaning: The newly written branch bit of axis i.
symbols.quote: Here $u_i$ is axis $i$'s current length, $b_i$ its new branch bit and $k_i$ the index encoded by its unprocessed slots, so $E$ depends on the address, not on coefficient values.

symbols.name: encoded index
symbols.meaning: The index encoded by the still unprocessed slots of axis i.
symbols.quote: Here $u_i$ is axis $i$'s current length, $b_i$ its new branch bit and $k_i$ the index encoded by its unprocessed slots, so $E$ depends on the address, not on coefficient values.

After all $a$ rounds the named slots from high to low hold the frequency bits from low to high, so $(F_t^-z)_j$ is stored at slot $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$, where $\operatorname{rev}_a$ reverses the $a$ binary digits.
The opposite procedure runs the levels backwards; since $H_0^2=I/2$, each reversed level is half the inverse of the forward level, over $a=\log_2t$ levels.
The reverse procedure composed with $B_tF_t^-$ is $2^{-a}I=I/t$, and as $F_t^+B_t^{-1}B_tF_t^-=F_t^+F_t^-=I/t$ by character cancellation, the two reverse operators agree.
So the two exact procedures implement $B_tF_t^-$ and $F_t^+B_t^{-1}$.
